sources.title: Muse Wonder: A Frontier Model For Personal & Professional AI Agents
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The October 12 launch treats Wonder and Wonder Full separately and states that both build on larger, stronger base models in its comparison with Spark 1.3. It publishes no nominal total or active count and does not identify either Wonder model as sharing the Spark base; the qualitative size comparison does not specify total versus active parameters.

sources.title: Muse Wonder Model Card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 and checked the full 13-page PDF, including the October 23 evaluation correction. Covers Wonder and Wonder Full, with separate performance results and Full safety evaluations, but contains no total or activated parameter count or parameter-comparison table for either variant.

sources.title: Models - Meta Model API
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Maps muse-wonder-1.0 to ordinary Wonder and distinguishes the subscription-only Full variant. The Wonder section documents 1,048,576-token context, text/image/video/audio/PDF input, text output and tools but no parameter count. Its separate Spark Open section gives 816B total/42B active, without extending those specifications to Wonder.

sources.title: Reasoning - Meta Model API
sources.evidence: Wonder supports minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, and max reasoning effort. None returns HTTP 400. Max on muse-wonder-1.0 does not select Wonder Full.

sources.title: Meta Model API Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Sections 1 and 10 govern hosted model access through restricted service rights and protect proprietary underlying components; separate open-weight licenses do not govern API access.

sources.title: Muse Spark Open Model Card
sources.evidence: Reopened the public rendered Meta card October 27, 2026. Specifies nominal 816B total/42B active and MoE Transformer for Muse Spark Open. No Wonder parameter row or same-base lineage statement is present; these are not Wonder specifications.

sources.title: Put your ideas to work with Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The October 12 developer launch distinguishes API Wonder from subscription-only Full, with separate evaluation columns and access instructions. It describes reasoning, tool use, long-running coding, Active Memory and Active Focus without total or active counts or a named base-model parameter lineage. Its audio caveat is resolved for this entry by the exact-model API input specification.

sources.title: Muse Wonder | Meta
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Displays distinct Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full variants and evaluation results, but no nominal total or active parameter specification, architecture, or named base model with a published size.

sources.title: Muse Spark Is Now an Open-Weights Model
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The October 15 post gives Spark Open 816B total/42B active, explicitly says it shares the same base as Spark 1.3, and links its additional safety post-training lineage to the August Spark release. No Wonder or Wonder Full relationship is stated; the newly established Spark lineage cannot override the Wonder launch describing larger bases.

sources.title: TorchTitan Update: New SOTA Models, Performance at Scale, TitanRL
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Under Muse Spark Open, identifies the release as MuseSpark 1.2 OSS and discusses its training efficiency. This supports the named Spark lineage, but provides no Wonder parameter disclosure or Wonder connection.

sources.title: Muse Spark Open | Meta
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. States that Spark Open is derived from the Muse Spark model released in August with additional safety post-training. Its comparison table has no Wonder row and establishes no link from either Wonder variant to the released Spark weights.

name.note: Official display name; 1.0 is carried in the exact API identifier. Full is separate.

developer.note: The model provider is Meta Platforms, Inc. or Meta Platforms Ireland Limited.

family.note: Normalized Muse umbrella family; Wonder is its named series.

release_date.note: Announcement and card explicitly establish the public launch. October 23 is an evaluation correction, not a new release.

open_weights.note: The documented release provides hosted service access; the separately identified downloadable Muse releases are Spark Open and Glimmer.

license.note: Descriptive classification of restricted Meta Model API service terms, not the Muse Model License used for separate open-weight releases.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 primary-source search found no nominal total for muse-wonder-1.0 or a named base with a published count. Meta describes both Wonder variants as using larger bases than Spark 1.3, so the newly documented Spark Open/1.2/1.3 lineage does not support transferring 816B to Wonder. The qualitative comparison does not establish a numeric total-parameter bound.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 searches and primary-page/PDF checks found no active-parameter specification or original research comparison count for exact Wonder 1.0. Spark Open publishes 42B active with explicit Spark lineage, but no such lineage is documented for Wonder. Active Memory and Active Focus are capability names, not activated-parameter measurements; Wonder Full is separate.

architecture.note: Inspected cards and targeted first-party training/interpretability searches did not identify exact Wonder Transformer, dense, or MoE structure. Spark Open architecture is not evidence for Wonder.

context_window.note: Exact documented token capacity; the model card rounds this to 1M. This is context capacity, not a separate output allowance.

modalities.note: Exact-model API docs expressly include PDF and audio. The card lists core modalities; PDF is an accepted input format. No image/audio generation is claimed.

reasoning.note: Six effort levels from minimal through max; none is unsupported. Effort changes do not change this entry into Full.

tool_call.note: Documented tool invocation and parallel tool use for agentic workflows.

description.value: Meta's hosted multimodal reasoning model for coding, computer use, and tasks that require tools across multiple steps. Available through Meta Model API and Muse Code.
description.note: Concise supported capabilities and access; removes unqualified frontier and promotional labels.

sources.label: Spark Open lineage (PyTorch Team at Meta)

patch.notes: This entry is muse-wonder-1.0, distinct from subscription-only Muse Wonder Full. Max reasoning effort does not select Full; none is unsupported. Total parameters, active parameters and architecture remain undisclosed. Meta describes larger bases than Spark 1.3, so Spark Open’s 816B total/42B active cannot be transferred through the documented Spark lineage. October 23 is a model-card evaluation correction, not the release date.
patch.description: Meta's hosted multimodal reasoning model for coding, computer use, and tasks that require tools across multiple steps. Available through Meta Model API and Muse Code.

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter re-audit reopened the Wonder launch, full 13-page card, model page, developer launch and API specification, plus the Spark Open card, Meta page and both PyTorch Team at Meta lineage posts. Targeted searches for nominal totals, activated counts and original research comparisons found no supported Wonder 1.0 count. Both parameter fields remain explicitly null/undisclosed: the newly documented Spark Open/1.2/1.3 relationship does not extend to Wonder, whose launch describes larger bases without identifying their sizes. Preserved all 12 unrelated field assessments; no endpoint execution or weight download was performed.
